title: Nimbus and the Rainbow Tears
prompt: A lonely cloud named Nimbus can't seem to make rain like the other clouds — until he discovers that his tears of laughter are the most beautiful rain of all

Nimbus.name: Nimbus
Nimbus.appearance: A small, extra-fluffy white cloud with soft rounded edges, slightly smaller than the other clouds. Has big, expressive sky-blue eyes and a gentle, shy smile. A faint golden shimmer glows around his edges when he's happy. No rain falls from him — he stays perfectly dry underneath.
Nimbus.personality: Gentle, shy, kind-hearted, a little insecure but full of hidden joy and warmth
Nimbus.notes: Unlike other clouds, Nimbus cannot produce regular rain. His special rain only comes from laughter and joy, and it sparkles in rainbow colors.

Cumulus.name: Cumulus
Cumulus.appearance: A large, broad, friendly-looking gray cloud with a wide face, kind hazel eyes, and a reassuring smile. Wears a tiny lightning-bolt pin on his side. Has a slightly darker underbelly showing he's good at making rain.
Cumulus.personality: Encouraging, patient, warm, a good friend who sees the best in others
Cumulus.notes: Cumulus is the first cloud to notice Nimbus is sad and tries to help him fit in.

The Flower Meadow.name: The Flower Meadow
The Flower Meadow.appearance: A vibrant meadow full of colorful wildflowers — daisies, poppies, sunflowers, and lavender — all drooping and thirsty, with a small brown bird sitting on a wilting sunflower.
The Flower Meadow.notes: The meadow and its creatures are the ones who help Nimbus discover his gift.

locations.The Sky - Cloud School: A bright, open expanse of blue sky with fluffy white clouds arranged in a semicircle, like a classroom. Soft sunlight streams from the upper corner. The atmosphere is bright and cheerful.
locations.The Sky - Quiet Corner: A quieter, more remote area of sky at the edge, with cooler blue-purple tones. A few wispy clouds drift by. The mood is peaceful but lonely.
locations.The Flower Meadow: A vibrant patchwork meadow seen from above, filled with daisies, poppies, sunflowers, and lavender. Rich green grass between colorful blooms. A small wooden fence borders one side. Warm, natural sunlight.
locations.The Sky - Above the Meadow: Open sky directly above the meadow, bright blue with a few scattered wisps. A clear view down to the flowers below. The light is warm and golden.
locations.The Sky - Sunset: A breathtaking sunset sky painted in warm oranges, pinks, purples, and gold. Soft, glowing light bathes everything. A few distant clouds catch the colorful light.
locations.The Sky - Wide Open Sky: A vast, expansive sky stretching in all directions, bright and clear with a warm golden glow. Below, a beautiful patchwork landscape of blooming gardens, green forests, and winding rivers stretches to the horizon.

bible.visual_style: Soft, dreamy watercolor-inspired digital illustrations with gentle pastel colors, fluffy textured clouds, and warm golden lighting. Characters have big, expressive eyes and rounded, friendly shapes. Sparkle and glow effects for magical moments. The overall feel is cozy, whimsical, and comforting — like a beloved picture book come to life.

scenes.title: The Cloud School
scenes.text: High up in the bright blue sky, all the young clouds were learning to make rain. They puffed up big and proud, letting gentle showers fall to the earth below. But little Nimbus tried and tried, and not a single drop came out.
scenes.description: A bright blue sky with several fluffy clouds of different sizes. In the center, small fluffy Nimbus looks strained and worried, cheeks puffed out, eyes squeezed shut. Around him, other clouds have gentle blue rain falling beneath them. The sun peeks from the corner. Soft, pastel color palette with warm golden sunlight.

scenes.title: Feeling Left Out
scenes.text: The other clouds cheered as their rain made the gardens grow. Nimbus floated away to a quiet corner of the sky, feeling small and useless. 'Why can't I make rain like everyone else?' he whispered to the wind.
scenes.description: Nimbus floats alone at the edge of the sky, looking down sadly with big droopy blue eyes. In the background, other clouds are happily raining over green landscapes with tiny rainbows. Nimbus is slightly translucent, looking small and lonely. The sky transitions from warm golden near the other clouds to cool blue-purple near Nimbus.

scenes.title: A Friend Appears
scenes.text: Just then, a big friendly cloud named Cumulus floated over. 'Hey there, little one,' he said warmly. 'I've seen you trying so hard. Maybe you're not broken — maybe you're just different in a wonderful way.'
scenes.description: Large, kind Cumulus floats next to tiny Nimbus. Cumulus has a warm, reassuring smile and is gently nudging Nimbus with his fluffy edge. Nimbus looks up with surprised, hopeful eyes. Soft pink and orange sunset light glows around them. The sky is a gentle gradient of lavender and peach.

scenes.title: Looking Down Together
scenes.text: Cumulus guided Nimbus to look down at the world below. There, a beautiful meadow of flowers was drooping and thirsty. A tiny brown bird sat on a wilting sunflower, looking up at the sky with hopeful eyes.
scenes.description: View from above looking down at a colorful but drooping flower meadow. Daisies, poppies, sunflowers, and lavender all bend downward, looking thirsty and tired. A small brown bird sits on a wilting sunflower, looking up. The colors of the flowers are slightly muted. Dry, cracked earth is visible between the flowers. Warm but slightly hazy light.

scenes.title: Trying Again
scenes.text: Nimbus puffed himself up as big as he could. He scrunched his face and squeezed his eyes shut, trying so hard to make rain for the thirsty flowers. But still... not a single drop fell.
scenes.description: Nimbus is puffed up to his maximum size, face scrunched up with effort, tiny eyebrows furrowed, fists clenched. His whole body is tense and slightly trembling. Below him, the thirsty flowers look up hopefully. Cumulus watches from the side with a supportive expression. The sky is bright blue with soft white wisps.

scenes.title: The Little Bird's Song
scenes.text: Then the tiny brown bird below began to sing the silliest, most wonderful song. It was so funny and sweet that Nimbus couldn't help it — a tiny giggle bubbled up inside him, then a chuckle, then a big, joyful belly laugh!
scenes.description: The small brown bird stands on the sunflower with its beak open wide, singing with musical notes floating around it. The bird looks playful and silly, wings spread in a funny dance pose. Above, Nimbus's expression is changing from sad to a wide, eyes-crinkled laugh, cheeks rosy. Golden sparkles begin to appear around Nimbus's edges. Warm, joyful lighting.

scenes.title: The Most Beautiful Rain
scenes.text: And then something magical happened! From Nimbus's happy tears of laughter, the most beautiful sparkling rain began to fall. Each drop shimmered with rainbow colors — pink, gold, blue, and green — twinkling like tiny jewels in the sunlight!
scenes.description: Nimbus is laughing with eyes closed in pure joy, mouth wide open in delight. From beneath him, sparkling rainbow-colored raindrops fall in a beautiful cascade. Each raindrop glows with different colors — pink, gold, turquoise, emerald green. The raindrops leave tiny trails of light. The entire scene is bathed in magical, prismatic light. Cumulus watches in amazement with wide eyes.

scenes.title: The Meadow Blooms
scenes.text: The rainbow rain touched the thirsty flowers, and they sprang back to life, more beautiful than ever! The little bird danced and sang, and the whole meadow sparkled with joy. Nimbus had never felt so happy!
scenes.description: The meadow below is now vibrantly alive — flowers stand tall and bright, glowing with extra-vivid colors. The brown bird dances happily mid-air with wings spread. Rainbow-tinted water droplets cling to petals and leaves like jewels. A soft rainbow arcs across the sky above. Nimbus floats above, glowing golden, smiling down with pure happiness. Everything is lush, vibrant, and sparkling.

scenes.title: A Special Gift
scenes.text: Cumulus smiled proudly at his little friend. 'You see, Nimbus? You were never broken. Your rain comes from joy — and that makes it the most beautiful rain in the whole wide sky.' Nimbus beamed, glowing brighter than ever before.
scenes.description: Cumulus and Nimbus float side by side in a warm sunset sky. Cumulus has a proud, gentle smile, looking down at Nimbus warmly. Nimbus glows with a bright golden light, smiling radiantly, eyes sparkling with happiness. Tiny rainbow droplets still gently fall from Nimbus. The sky is painted in warm oranges, pinks, and purples. Other clouds in the background look on with admiring expressions.

scenes.title: Nimbus's Promise
scenes.text: From that day on, Nimbus traveled the sky bringing his sparkling rainbow rain to every thirsty garden and sad little flower. And he learned that being different isn't something to hide — it's the most wonderful gift of all. Because the best things in life come straight from a joyful heart!
scenes.description: Nimbus floats happily across a vast, beautiful sky, leaving a trail of sparkling rainbow rain below. Underneath, a patchwork of gardens, meadows, and forests all bloom vibrantly. Multiple small rainbows dot the landscape. Nimbus glows golden and looks confident and happy. The scene is wide and panoramic, full of color and life. A warm, golden light fills the entire image.
